textos.A divergência central está na condução d: The central divergence lies in how the script and structure are handled: while most of those who do not recommend it point to a disjointed narrative with an unsatisfying ending, those who rate it positively highlight the characters' evolution built over the same story.
textos.Narrativa fragmentada e sem conclusão sa: Fragmented narrative without a satisfying conclusion
textos.O filme é apenas uma preparação para o p: The film is merely a setup for the next one, leaving the story without a real ending, which causes frustration.
textos.A trama se desenvolve de forma confusa e: The plot unfolds in a confusing, accelerated way, with events following one another without clear cohesion.
textos.Os personagens principais são pouco dese: The main characters are barely developed and the protagonist behaves in an immature, insufferable way.
textos.O filme se arrasta por muito tempo, com: The film drags on for a long time, with a slow first part and then a rushed ending, causing boredom.
textos.Excesso de metalinguagem e referências a: Excess of metalanguage and self-referential nods
textos.As constantes piadas, comentários metali: The constant jokes, meta commentary and references to other superhero films undermine the seriousness of the plot.
textos.O antagonista principal é introduzido de: The main antagonist is introduced comically and never poses a convincing threat, besides appearing less than expected.
textos.A animação é frequentemente elogiada com: The animation is often praised as impressive and innovative, with many highlighting the visual beauty and the creativity of the different styles of each universe, although some find the excess of styles visually tiring.
textos.A trama é considerada por muitos como um: The plot is considered by many to be a mere preparation for the third film, without a complete arc, resulting in a feeling that the main story does not advance satisfactorily.
textos.O ritmo é apontado como irregular, com l: The pace is described as uneven, with long stretches considered drawn out or boring, although the action and the final climax are often praised as exciting.
textos.A trilha sonora é geralmente elogiada, c: The soundtrack is generally praised, with many highlighting that the songs help set the atmosphere and match the scenes well, although some find it less memorable than that of the first film.
textos.O vilão é visto de forma mista, com algu: The villain is seen in a mixed way, with some considering him interesting and well developed, while others find him not threatening enough or his motivation confusing.
textos.O desenvolvimento dos personagens é vist: Character development is seen as inconsistent, with some characters receiving insufficient attention and the protagonist being criticized for acting irrationally at certain moments.
textos.A animação é considerada um marco histór: The animation is considered a historic landmark, with every frame looking like a work of art and a unique combination of visual styles.
textos.A música, especialmente a de Metro Boomi: The music, especially Metro Boomin's, is praised for heightening the intensity of the scenes and perfectly complementing the narrative.
textos.Os arcos de Miles e Gwen são destacados: The arcs of Miles and Gwen are highlighted as moving and well built, with emphasis on the relationship between Gwen and her father.
textos.A trama é considerada mais séria e madur: The plot is considered more serious and mature than the previous one, exploring themes like identity and destiny, and being one of the best Spider-Man stories.
textos.Cliffhanger e expectativa pela continuaç: Cliffhanger and anticipation for the sequel
textos.O final deixa muitas pontas soltas, o qu: The ending leaves many loose ends, which causes frustration but also great anticipation for the next film, being one of the most discussed points.
textos.Ritmo frenético e excesso de informações: Frenetic pace and excess of information
textos.Alguns acham o filme visualmente cansati: Some find the film visually tiring and overstimulating, although this does not diminish the overall enjoyment.

Released in 2023 and directed by Justin K. Thompson, Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse is an action, adventure and science fiction animation. In the plot, Miles Morales travels across the Multiverse and joins forces with Gwen Stacy and a new team of Spider-People to face a dangerous threat.
textos.A experiência do longa é marcada por um: The experience of the film is marked by a fast pace and a dense overlay of dynamic visual styles throughout its entire running time.
textos.Na grande maioria das notas (~93%), a ma: In the vast majority of ratings (~93%), most praise the work's innovative, impressive animation. In addition, a portion of this group praises the striking soundtrack, while a smaller slice highlights character development in the narrative.
textos.Para quem está nessa faixa, numa fração: For those in this range, at a minimal fraction of ratings (~6%), the focus falls intensely on the visual direction: a large portion analyze the animation and its different visual styles, most discuss how the story unfolds in relation to its structure and a significant share point to fluctuations in pace.
textos.Já na perspectiva de quem avalia numa fr: From the perspective of those rating at an even smaller fraction of ratings (~1%), many criticize the fragmented narrative without a satisfying conclusion. In this same group, several consider the plot rushed and disorderly, and a considerable number point to weak or irritating character development.
